Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4689845 that have an exact measurement (standard_relation '=' and standard_value is not null). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
